placements.title: Shifting Weekday Operating Hours for Commuter Returns While Keeping Staffing Flat
placements.frame: how should weekday branch operating hours be adjusted to accommodate commuter return traffic without increasing total staffing hours?
placements.why: Moira and Teo outline a coordinated schedule shift on Tuesdays and Thursdays: opening early at eight to accommodate commuter book returns while closing an hour early to preserve flat staffing levels.
